en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Muhammad Bin Ali Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Mighty and Majestic
[71:28] My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who enters my house believing
– Meaning the Wilayah. The one who enteres into the Wilayah enters into the House of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
[33:33] But rather, Allah Desires to Keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House! And to Purify you a with a Purification
– Meaning the Imams<sup>asws</sup> and their<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah. The one who enters into it, enters into the House of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>’.
